Name: Passable Farm Animals
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Passable Farm Animals[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Allows seamless walking through farm animals instead of the vanilla "hiccup" and slowdown when colliding with said animal.


[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Walk through farm animals without slowdown[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] -> optional but recommended[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Adjust settings via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu in-game.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[line]
✅ Built for Stardew Valley 1.6+
✅ Multiplayer compatible
❌ N/A
